model: ChatGPT GPT-6 High; isolated unpersonalized temporary chat per trial
pdf_condition: All 3 original issuer PDFs unchanged, 510+4+4 pages.
text_condition: Three researcher-selected transcriptions: name and printed percentages for every security line on annual PDF pages 252 and 317 and continuation tables, and the full dated top-ten lists of both factsheets. Page retrieval and representation change together. Both arms use attachments and identical natural-language questions.
score: Before dispatch. Separately score form, printed-value endpoints (both individually within 0.005 pp), cap decision, and citations. A/C require supported points. B/D require September bounds. A cap is inclusive. Numerical and decision success are distinct. Evidence needs the correct documents, as-of date and pages, allowing clearly mapped printed/PDF numbering. Record stale carry-forward, unlisted-as-zero and wrong maturity only when supported by visible answers. No output is a technical delivery event. One first response per cell, no repeats for performance.
interpretation: One account, two dates, two funds; B and D deliberately share the exposure. Eight requests, four case pairs, three distinct exposure calculations. Descriptive, no population or novelty claim. Internal PDF parsing and retrieval are unobserved.
bounds_convention: Use printed weights, direct long holding, nonnegative unknown position, rankings by displayed holding weight and a possible tie at cutoff. Actual imprecisely rounded economic exposures are outside scope.
